reason: We do free storytime at the Wicomico library most Tuesdays, plus parks and church groups. I'd maybe go once or twice a month, so $49-59 a month for a membership doesn't make sense on our budget.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership, and $12 a visit for free-activity people like us adds up fast.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap first visit, or a drop-in price around $5 with the drink included, so I could try it without committing.
